name: poe2-helper
description: PoE2 Helper — deterministic Path of Exile 2 build helper

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w @poe2-helper/domain && npm run typecheck -w @poe2-helper/data-sources && npm run typecheck -w @poe2-helper/passive-engine && npm run typecheck -w @poe2-helper/scoring-engine && npm run typecheck -w @poe2-helper/gear-engine && npm run typecheck -w @poe2-helper/character-context && npm run typecheck -w @poe2-helper/pob2-calculator
